capabilities.name: Versioned task state events
capabilities.description: Appends bounded task-scoped events with monotonic per-task revisions, per-task and aggregate event capacity, and deterministic snapshots within one process.
limitations: State is in-memory and process-local; no durability or replication is provided.
Actor identifiers are metadata only; no writer authentication or authorization exists.
Aggregate event capacity is bounded by the configured store limit (100,000 by default).

capabilities.name: Event ID idempotency
capabilities.description: Returns the existing snapshot for an identical event ID and rejects conflicting reuse within process lifetime.

capabilities.name: Opaque context references
capabilities.description: Stores bounded opaque context references without dereferencing or executing content.
